## Body

From #266: keep route telemetry bounded with a sorted, deduplicated immutable table built from Endpoint::ALL. Binary search must use the constructor's string ordering; absent templates share unmatched. Inline atomics avoid a per-response mutex and per-route Arc clone. Count outside bearer middleware AND separately authenticated job-token routes. GET /v1/seats performs two increments, not one.

Relaxed atomics prevent lost increments but do not make route/shape snapshots transactional. Derive total from the values actually read and use explicit wrapping arithmetic if counter wrap is the contract; ordinary additions can panic under overflow checks.

Concurrency-proof trap: spawning writers, looping while any is unfinished, then asserting snapshots > 0 is scheduler-dependent: all writers may finish before the reader runs. Require an explicit reader/writer rendezvous to guarantee observation during recording. Joining writers before asserting exact final totals is sound. This was a nonblocking C34 follow-up in round 2, not a reason for a third round.
